svg.title: Compression selection and nested VAE adaptive compression diagram
svg.desc: The figure has a left rounded panel for compression selection, an optional dashed image-pair frame below it, and a large right rounded panel showing a nested VAE pipeline. Left panel content is arranged vertically from title to complexity labels, arrows, an LLM evaluation box, text descriptions, then arrows to two example images. The right panel starts from a beach image at left, then proceeds left-to-right through encoder downsampling blocks, nested colored compression paths, latent sampling, decoder upsampling blocks, and a color legend. Confirmed SAM picture assets replace the constructed beach/monitor photo regions while retaining text, arrows, borders, and all vector pipeline geometry.

g.title: Left panel content is top-to-bottom: title, low/high complexity labels, vertical arrows, LLM evaluation box, natural language descriptions, and examples in dashed optional area.
Right panel content proceeds left-to-right from beach input to encoder downsampling, shared latent sampling, and decoder upsampling with nested green, blue, and purple compression paths.
